description: This file provides functions for parsing source code files, especially TypeScript, using tree-sitter. It includes logic for handling various file types, extracting code definitions, and filtering HTML elements in certain languages. It also manages minimum component size for code components and supports markdown parsing.

methods.name: getMinComponentLines
methods.description: Returns the current minimum number of lines for a component to be included.

methods.name: setMinComponentLines
methods.description: Sets the minimum number of lines for a component, primarily for testing purposes.
